name: Teets Cattle Company
old_description: At Teets Cattle Company, we believe simple is best. That’s why we take pride in raising our cattle and crops right here on our farm alongside our family. We work together as a family to provide food for our nation.
about:
Teets Cattle Company operates from Lost River, West Virginia, where Matt and Jill Teets run the family farm alongside their sons Justin, JW, and Jordan. The business centers on raising cattle and crops on their own land, following a straightforward approach the family describes as "simple is best." No founding year is publicly stated.

The farm produces beef sold directly as quality cuts, and the family also raises crops. Beyond daily operations, Teets Cattle Company hosts annual agricultural events that draw regional participants, including the Bulls N' Barrels Rodeo, the Teets/Griswold Mt Classic Production Sale, and the Teets/Griswold Pounds to Profit Bull Sale. Facility size, headcount, and annual volumes are not disclosed.

Customers include local consumers seeking farm-raised beef and participants in the farm's production sales, which serve cattle producers and buyers in the livestock industry. The operation sits within the agriculture and food production sectors, with a focus on beef cattle.

The Teets family frames the business around traditional values, a love of the land, and hard work, emphasizing sustainability and family tradition as guiding principles. They state they work together to provide food for the nation.
